figS01_joint_spectrum_2d.chengdu_frequency: 18 observed hours (06--23), 18-point DFT, bins m=0..9 at m/18 cycles per observed hour; no nighttime zero filling.
figS01_joint_spectrum_2d.data_definition: verified_joint.npz multiplicity-weighted full-band TRAIN joint energy shares, plotted as discrete 2-D heat maps; x = frequency-specific SVD rank, y = one-sided DFT frequency per observed hour.

figS02_heldout_daily_scores.daily_D_policy: No city archives daily D. The real available fold-level pooled D diagnostic is used instead; no daily D values are invented.
figS02_heldout_daily_scores.data_definition: Top: obj_*.json per_date.dates[].R (daily raw P) for fold 0/only split; dashed line is energy-weighted pooled R_P. Bottom: each fold's frames_frozen pooled R_P and R_D.
figS02_heldout_daily_scores.fold_policy: SF uses folds 0--4. Porto folds 1--4 exactly duplicate fold 0 and are excluded as independent evidence. No fold mean is called pooled.

Chengdu.definition: per_date.dates[].R; raw P frame; points are not interpolated

Porto.definition: per_date.dates[].R; raw P frame; points are not interpolated

SF.definition: per_date.dates[].R; raw P frame; points are not interpolated

figS03_coherent_response_train_test.aggregation: SF thin lines are five folds, bold is their arithmetic mean and shading their range; Porto/Chengdu are single-split curves. These are coherent-mode summaries, not pooled prediction scores.
figS03_coherent_response_train_test.chengdu_frequency: All ten bins of the observed 18-hour DFT at m/18 cycles per observed hour; the old obj_Chengdu h<=4 display and not-reported region are not used.
figS03_coherent_response_train_test.data_definition: For each bin and fold: delta_alignment = TEST cos - TRAIN cos; delta_norm_ratio = TEST norm ratio - TRAIN norm ratio. Porto/SF use coherent.{train,test} and gain_op/gain_emp; Chengdu uses chengdu_response18.npz train_cos/train_rho and TEST cos/rho for every m=0..9.

records.difference_from_main_figure_4: main Figure 4 shows absolute TEST alignment and norm ratio; this supplement shows TEST-minus-TRAIN changes

figS04_anisotropy_distributions.data_definition: ECDF of A_C (response) and A_U (road support) on identical full cell sets; A=(lambda1-lambda2)/(lambda1+lambda2). Zero-response cells remain in the distributions.
figS04_anisotropy_distributions.frame: Chengdu primary frame D; frame P is not substituted.

Chengdu.endpoint_rule: np.clip to [0,1] only after all values pass a 5e-15 endpoint tolerance

Porto.endpoint_rule: np.clip to [0,1] only after all values pass a 5e-15 endpoint tolerance

SF.endpoint_rule: np.clip to [0,1] only after all values pass a 5e-15 endpoint tolerance

figS05_matched_capacity.data_definition: At R=n_int, conditional R2(source)-conditional R2(constant R=1) for permuted mobility, road and mobility-inferred media; separate axis is archived paired-date mobility-road mean and 95% bootstrap interval.
figS05_matched_capacity.limitations: Chengdu uses default channel, perfold basis and four held-out dates; SF uses passenger channel. Intervals exist only for the contrast, not individual media.

figS06_heldout_reconstruction.data_definition: Observed date24/date18 and reconstructed hat24/hat18 road-subspace fields at archived picked_i/picked_phase; raw24/raw18 are not drawn. Opacity uses each city's own observed p99 and is not an absolute cross-city scale.
figS06_heldout_reconstruction.frame_policy: All three cities use P-frame reconstructions from raw TEST inputs/targets. Chengdu hat18 is the P-frame pred_p readout; D is used only for an independent cross-check and not for selection or drawing.

Chengdu.D_role: independent cross-check only; not used for selection or drawing

figS06_heldout_reconstruction.selection: Porto/SF preserve their archived picked_i/picked_phase without reselection. Chengdu uses the median per-date P-error date (picked_i=2, picked_date=16304); phase 6 in the 06--23 window is 12:00.

figS07_nonlinear_exploratory.data_definition: Chengdu-only exploratory diagnostics. A: full-FACE pooled TEST errors for M_zero/M_shared/M_shared_bal/M_freq/M_pool plus the three daily errors. D: full-FACE dR2 and 95% date-bootstrap intervals for quadF/krrF relative to linF.

M_freq.aggregation: pooled archive value is not replaced by a daily mean

M_pool.aggregation: pooled archive value is not replaced by a daily mean

M_shared.aggregation: pooled archive value is not replaced by a daily mean

M_shared_bal.aggregation: pooled archive value is not replaced by a daily mean

M_zero.aggregation: pooled archive value is not replaced by a daily mean

records.D_definition: dR2 = mean_date(E_linF) - mean_date(E_nonlinear); positive favors the nonlinear arm
records.POD_policy: Only full-FACE values are drawn. Inside-TRAIN-POD scores are archived separately and are not mixed into either panel.
records.full_FACE_definition: zero prediction outside selected TRAIN routing POD; out-of-POD energy retained
records.scope: Chengdu only; exploratory; 3 TEST dates; underpowered; no cross-city or no-nonlinearity inference

statistical_limitation.note: 9999 bootstrap draws do not create independent information; with three dates there are only 27 ordered resamples. CIs are descriptive reference-defined intervals.

figS07_nonlinear_exploratory.scope: exploratory; 3 TEST dates; underpowered. Only full-FACE values are drawn; inside-POD scores are not substituted. No absence-of-nonlinearity or confirmatory frequency-flat verdict is supported.

scope: Only reports/threecity_supplement is written; source figures and manuscript files are read-only.
